task_abi: All1536 task bits are retained. Fields unpack using replay_control_layout_pkg generated from replay_contract.json; no manually maintained offsets.
clock: All ports clk synchronous except combinational safety inhibition from already-normalized inputs; coordinated synchronous rst. No CDC or physical GPIO inside.
submit: submit_valid one-cycle attempt; submit_accepted/rejected and reason from queue. Producer must already own immutable task/calibration/profile references and actual bank replay lease before submitting. A rejected submit does not transfer or release those references.

lookup.output: lookup_valid and lookup_task are current queued head, including all bank/source/profile IDs
lookup.input: lookup_ready asserts only when current_generation/config_id/fir_id/source_epoch and bank_frozen/data_ready/qualified/lease_pinned/source_stable/profile/guard/slot/resource proofs refer to this exact head. current_owner_epoch is global current owner epoch, not head-specific historical state.
lookup.proofs: task_profiles_valid must validate and retain all requested RX/TX/target/FD/reference/doppler versions; latency_validated and downstream_latency_ticks must reflect actual pinned pipeline. RF binding and rf_safe are trusted normalized live safety inputs, never raw software enables.
lookup.processing_ready: Separate readiness of the single downstream DSP task engine. It delays dispatch while the head continues deadline/legal revalidation; it is not used as an invalidity proof. Tie resource proofs to actual frozen-bank/port/slot legality, not transient DSP busy if queuing is intended.

dispatch.atomic: Queue dispatch and actual reader task admission occur on same clock using the same head/proofs/GSC. active_task snapshots full descriptor; task_started is the reader's registered accepted pulse. Metadata persists until next dispatch or reset, so downstream snapshots at task_started.
dispatch.raw: raw_valid/data are actual reader responses, no backpressure. raw_last=raw_valid&&actual_finish identifies final real RAM sample. ram_en/address/group/bank connect to existing FROZEN A-port mux; ram_response_valid/data are fixed one-clock RAM responses.
dispatch.time: Reader computes schedule once from target/reference and validated downstream latency; accepted times never change when the queue head changes. Actual start/finish GSC events are passed through.
dispatch.runtime_cancel: hard_fault, time/clock failure, explicit abort, RF permission/binding loss or global owner epoch mismatch suppress data/reads and invoke existing reader drain/cancellation. Missing fixed response yields actual reader UNDERFLOW token; no fabricated samples.

ownership.real_token: token_valid/payload/status/ready are exclusively existing reader outputs. Queue inflight and same-bank exclusion retire only when this real token is accepted downstream. Backpressure holds the token and prevents next reader dispatch.
ownership.queued_reject: rejected_valid/task/reason are held until reject_ready. A stale/late/illegal task not dispatched to RAM produces no bank-return token. Caller must disposition previously pinned producer references safely before acknowledging; this module never assumes an unproven lease exists.
ownership.defensive_admission_reject: If the reader independently refuses despite head legality, retain active task/reason as held rejection and clear only queue bookkeeping on reject_ready. No RAW token is synthesized because no RAM read was admitted.
ownership.DSP_lifetime: RAW token is not full DSP completion and does not release calibration/matrix/FD/task references. The downstream processing chain must keep processing_ready low through FIR tails and final arithmetic drain, hold its own copied metadata, and manage its coefficient references separately.
ownership.idle: idle covers queue, active reader, held token and rejection only. Root global quiescence must additionally include the DSP chain, metadata/profile leases and producer work. Hard reset requires external coordinated drain/isolation.

limits: Root lookup/profile/guard resolver and DMA/bank-return wiring remain external
No RF enable signal or board binding validation inferred
Vivado synthesis/timing and final DSP chain integration not claimed
